items.name: Total company backlog, Q3 2026
items.claim: General Dynamics reported total backlog of $220,339 million (funded $111,796 million plus unfunded $108,543 million) at the end of the third quarter of 2026, plus $50,330 million of estimated potential contract value, for total estimated contract value of $270,669 million. The prior-quarter comparative in the same exhibit was total backlog of $136,498 million, so unfunded backlog rose from $32,387 million to $108,543 million, concentrated in Marine Systems.

items.name: Combat Systems segment backlog, Q3 2026
items.claim: General Dynamics' Combat Systems segment, which includes its GD-OTS ammunition and weapons businesses, carried funded backlog of $26,983 million and unfunded backlog of $1,701 million for total backlog of $28,684 million, plus estimated potential contract value of $9,588 million, for total estimated contract value of $38,272 million, at the end of the third quarter of 2026. The prior-quarter comparative in the same exhibit was total backlog of $29,350 million.
